'''Zalin Lih''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was considered the greatest adversary of [[Gester Noxx]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] active [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Noxx marooned Lih in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], and Lih's [[Holojournal/Legends|holojournal]] detailing his last days was discovered centuries later.<ref name="The Gangster's Graveyard" />
